review_stage: Focused Stage1 meaning recheck after wording repairs

focused_claim.answer: Correct for the constant-rate thinning construction described in the paragraph. Candidate events have rate M*lambda. Keeping every Mth event gives retained interval mean M/(M*lambda)=1/lambda and variance M/(M*lambda)^2=1/(M*lambda^2). Hence mean rate remains lambda and CV is 1/sqrt(M). The stated more-regular-than-Poisson model has M>1; M=1 would leave variability unchanged. The paragraph does not apply independent constant-rate intervals to the complete recurrent network at changing rates.
focused_claim.source: Ben-Shushan et al.2022 main p.11, Sub-Poisson spike trains, explicitly states average firing unchanged and CV reduced; earlier 04c-eye-circuit.md lines130-146 gives the interval derivation.
